status: ready_for_freeze; prospective sampling remains forbidden until root supplies the actual immutable freeze commit and explicit authorization
discovery_only: All existing lag1 and sqrtN results are discovery/planning inputs, excluded from prospective estimates and covariance
sample_budget_rule: fixed totals; no significance monitoring, extension, rescue source, fourth numerical template, new lag, or newly selected N after reveal
source: For each final K>=1, retain the early rank probabilities at K-1, tilt configurations within each early rank by exp(t*s_(K-1)), normalize within that layer, and add one uniform vacant site. s=CB+CW in bulk units; the first-order score is s-E[s|K-1,r,g]. K=0 tangent=0.
source_boundary: one-step-before-readout conditional policy; not equilibrium source s_K or sqrtN-lag source; all models use exactly this same protocol
nuisance_rule: The conditional-policy functional is frozen, not numerical discovery estimates of mu. Re-estimate mu(K-1,r,g) and the pooled matching root on the new data and inside each paired delete-one. This is a prespecified estimator, not model-parameter refitting.
thermal_rule: Differentiate only Bin(N,p) weights. Hold the lag, per-K source definition and microcanonical conditional mean function fixed when differentiating p.
source_units: derivative with respect to exp(t*bulk_cluster_count); no extra factor N

readout_channels.addback: U=U_entry+U_completion; v=v_entry+v_completion. Both readout derivatives use the same FULL-source p0dot and Ddot, not separate channel roots.
readout_channels.interpretation: A decomposition of a normalized readout under one source, not causal attribution of the source to different events. The distinct event-kernel tangent decomposition must not be substituted. Direct0->2 stays in q and root/slope response.

model_scope: Each model requires its component intervals at BOTH N85 and N340. These are mutually exclusive, nonexhaustive finite-scale numerical predictions, not three physical theories. Thresholds are declared decision resolutions, not natural constants. All three may fail, including values in the gaps or mixed/negative responses.

net_transmission_primary.downgrade_rule: If the simultaneous intervals for net v at BOTH N lie wholly within[-.50,.50], stop treating this lag1 source as the current main H4 explanation at this declared resolution. This is not proof of exact zero or a rejection of every source/field.
net_transmission_primary.positive_transmission_rule: If both simultaneous net-v lower bounds exceed+.50, the finite-scale positive net-transmission target survives; no continuum identity or full norm4 scaling is inferred.
net_transmission_primary.otherwise: Report negative, inconsistent or unresolved net transmission as observed; do not replace the source, alter thresholds or add samples.

inference.primary_family: six correlated coordinates: entry,completion,net at N85 and N340
inference.interval_rule: marginal estimate +/- critical_value * paired-delete-one SE; full6x6 covariance saved; net is derived from components, not independent evidence
inference.coverage_boundary: Bonferroni controls multiplicity conditional on valid marginal asymptotic normal approximations; these are not exact finite-sample confidence certificates
inference.kill_rule: A numerical template is contradicted if any required component confidence interval has empty intersection with its declared allowed interval at either N. A remaining template is only not excluded; no forced winner.
inference.support_rule: Confidence intervals lying wholly within a template permit a bounded finite-scale numerical compatibility statement, not identification of a physical mechanism.
inference.dependence: same permutation paired across the two geometries; all K and channels share the same N-batch; explicit independent N domains, 200 delete-one batches per N; old discovery data never pooled
inference.variance_gate: If realized variance exceeds the protected plan, finish the fixed run and report the loss of power. No automatic top-up.

power_plan.planning_variance_source: old lag1 canonical channel covariance; scales as old_M/new_M only for planning
power_plan.boundary_power_scope: approximately90.4% for a single worst-channel .30-gap rejection at N340 under the protected variance; not simultaneous probability of selecting a correct model, and not power at every point of a composite set

random_domain.independence_boundary: The tagged(seed,N,counter) identities are new and disjoint from the reviewed discovery domains. Statistical independence still uses the standard PRNG assumption; no impossible claim of collision-free64-bit state space is made.

production_gate: run_production.py refuses sampling without a root-supplied authorization JSON naming the actual40-hex freeze_commit and matching SHA256 of contract, engine, scorer, numerical core, and vendors
resource_plan: N340 eight shards of25 batches=20M each; N85 one shard of200 batches=5M.14 workers per assigned machine, BLAS1. Actual resource assignment by root. No new sample exists at draft time.
